007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for dropping a Select AI profile.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
020 * {@link Profile} object for an existing profile, call
021 * {@link Profile#drop(boolean)}, and print whether the drop operation
022 * succeeded.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by dropping the profile identified by
025 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}. Verify the profile name before running it.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
028 * <ul>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
033 * </ul>
034 *
035 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
036 * <ul>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_DROP_FORCE - set to {@code true} to request force drop.
038 *       Defaults to {@code false}.</li>
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
042 * <pre>{@code
043 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
044 * }</pre>
045 *
046 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
047 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
048 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
049 * <pre>{@code
050 * mvn clean install
051 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
052 * }</pre>
053 *
054 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
055 * <pre>{@code
056 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
057 *   -d samples/out \
058 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/DropProfileSample.java
059 * }</pre>
060 *
061 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
062 * <pre>{@code
063 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
064 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.DropProfileSample
065 * }</pre>
066 *
067 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
068 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
069 * and diagnostics.</p>
070 */
071public final class DropProfileSample {
072    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DropProfileSample.class);
073
074    private DropProfileSample() {
075    }
076
077    public static void main(String[] args) {
078        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
079        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_DROP_FORCE", "false"));
080
081        try {
082            DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
083                    .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
084                    .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
085                    .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
086                    .build();
087
088            SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
089            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
090            boolean dropped = profile.drop(force);
091
092            System.out.printf("Drop profile '%s' completed: %s%n", profileName, dropped);
093        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
094            LOGGER.error("Failed to drop Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
095        }
096    }
097
098    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
099        String value = System.getenv(name);
100        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
101            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
102        }
103        return value;
104    }
105
106    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
107        String value = System.getenv(name);
108        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
109    }
110}
